## Maintenance Calendar

Wraps the generic Calendar (extended additively, not forked) with the maintenance vocabulary: scheduled/due Work Orders become solid, draggable chips coloured by status; each active Maintenance Plan's `nextDueAt` becomes a dashed PROJECTED chip so the eye can tell "booked" from "expected" at a glance. A kind/status filter row sits above; a day's `+` mints a new Work Order via `onSelectDay` (host wires it to `createCard`, not a manual save-then-open pair).

Clicking a chip opens the shared catalog Popover with a compact `:details` read (title, status, priority, checklist progress). Both popover actions hand off to the real Work Order card via `onOpenWorkOrder(wo, format)` — `viewCard`, a top-level component arg, never `context.actions` — "Open full record" opens it `isolated` (the full technician workbench), "Quick edit" opens it `edit` (every field, grouped). No compact mini-form editing in the popover itself.

### Non-goals

Not the generic Calendar block itself (that stays domain-agnostic) — this is the maintenance vocabulary layer on top of it.
